CITY OF ALHAMBRA PLANNING COMMISSION
  ACTION MINUTES

  Regular Meeting
  July 7, 2025

  The audio and video recordings of the meeting are available here: PC Meeting – July 7,
  2025 (Audio).m4a / PC Meeting – July 7, 2025 (Video).mp4

A.  CALL MEETING TO ORDER:  7:01 P.M. in the Council Chambers of Alhambra City Hall,
  and via video conference and teleconference.

B.  ROLL CALL:

  Present:  Chen, Dorado, Grijalva, Ho, Mojarro, Garcia, Olson

  Absent:  Gardea, Juarez

  Staff Present: Vanessa Reynoso, Deputy Director; Maia McCurley, Principal Planner;
  Karabeth Garcia, Executive Assistant; Erica Vega, Deputy City Attorney

C.  FLAG SALUTE:  Led by President Olson

D.  CONSENT AGENDA:

  AGENDA
  ITEM 1:  MINUTES – MAY 19, 2025 (7:02 P.M.)
  • Request: This is a request for the Planning Commission to
  approve the Minutes of the May 19, 2025, Regular Meeting of the
  Alhambra Planning Commission.
  • Recommended Action: Commission review and approve as
  submitted the Minutes of the May 19, 2025, Regular Meeting of
  the Alhambra Planning Commission.

  AGENDA

F.  PUBLIC HEARINGS:

  AGENDA
  ITEM 4:  ZONING  TEXT  AMENDMENT  AMD-25-03  (HISTORIC
  PRESERVATION ORDINANCE) (7:04 P.M.)
  •  This is a City-initiated application for Zoning Text Amendment AMD-25-
  03 to adopt a Historic Preservation Ordinance establishing regulations
  and standards for designating historic resources within the City and
  regulating designated resources as part of a comprehensive Historic
  Preservation Program, as well as amending various sections of the
  Alhambra Municipal Code to establish consistency with the proposed
  Historic Preservation Ordinance.
  •  Recommended Action: Adopt Resolution No. 25-04 recommending that
  the Planning Commission and City Council adopt Zoning Text
  Amendment AMD-25-03, a Historic Preservation Ordinance establishing
  regulations and standards for designating historic resources within the
  City and regulating designated resources as part of a comprehensive
  Historic Preservation Program.
  •  Principal Planner Maia McCurley provided the Staff presentation.
  •  The City’s consultant, Historic Resources Group (HRG), and sub-
  consultant, Architectural Resources Group (ARG), provided the
  presentation.
  •  The public hearing was opened and then closed.
